description: FNPF AMR wave breaking: steep cnoidal waves (B 92 8) on a 1:10 slope with the static coastline (A 343 1, A 341), breaking A 350 1 inside the patch (3-6 m, it breaks at 5-6 m); the patch is kept off the coastline (shoreline at 7 m).
covers: fnpf_amr::cell_unfit and the dryband: tiles kept off dry, thin and coastline-band cells
fnpf_amr::patch_breaking: detection on the patches (set_local), the viscosity of the source grid around a patch (fill_run)
fnpf_amr::patch_damping: implicit damping with the breaking viscosity on the patch box
